contents.name: Section 4.1.1, equation (4.2a): minimally coupled charged scalar equation
contents.support: Provides an independent full-text treatment of the charged scalar equation. The local Definition fixes its sign using the exact potential in def-emg-xs-rn-data and defines the fixed-background model explicitly.

contents.name: Sections 4.1.1 and 4.6.1, equations (4.3)-(4.4) and (4.55)
contents.support: Supports the RN charged-scalar separation and radial coefficient. The radial identity itself is derived locally from the Definition's gauge, wave operator, and spherical-harmonic hypothesis.

contents.name: Section 4.4, equations (4.50)-(4.53), and Section 4.6.1, equation (4.56)
contents.support: Supplies an independent Wronskian scattering treatment and the charged horizon-frequency condition. The local proof evaluates the exact Coulomb-phase asymptotics specified in the Definition.

contents.name: Section 4.4, equation (4.52), unmodified plane-wave infinity asymptotic
contents.reason: The local radial coefficient has the long-range term -2 omega e Q/r. The Definition uses the required logarithmic Coulomb phase and the local Wronskian proof does not import this short-range plane-wave asymptotic.

contents.name: Section 4.1.1, equation (4.4), source gauge-sign convention
contents.support: The source's written background potential convention is not substituted for the exact A_t=-Q/r convention of the selected supplier. The local time factor gives D_t exp(-i omega t)=-i(omega-eQ/r) exp(-i omega t), fixing the sign used downstream.

contents.name: Chapter 3, Sections 3.1 and 3.2.2-3.2.4, equations (3.11)-(3.56)
contents.support: Supports the electric RN gauge, charged scalar operator, separated harmonic modes, and radial equation. Quantum-mode normalization and quantization are outside the local Definition.

contents.name: Chapter 3, Sections 3.2.2-3.2.4, equations (3.36)-(3.56)
contents.support: Provides a second independent separation calculation; the local proof supplies every radial differentiation step under its own exact sign convention.

contents.name: Chapter 3, Sections 3.3.1-3.3.4, equations (3.76)-(3.84)
contents.support: Supports the four scattering mode boundary conditions and Wronskian relations. The local result is restricted to the unit-incoming mode and pure ingoing-horizon condition specified in the Definition.

contents.name: Chapter 3, equation (3.59), simple plane-wave asymptotic at infinity
contents.reason: The exact charged radial coefficient has a 1/r Coulomb tail. The local Definition retains the logarithmic phase, which is checked directly from the coefficient and is not inferred from this simpler asymptotic.

contents.name: Chapter 3.4 and Part II quantum-field mode interpretation
contents.reason: The assigned page develops a classical fixed-background test-field equation; quantization, particle creation, and quantum state normalization are not used.
